0022600037.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-5) visit the Chicago Bulls (1-8) in their 13th game of the season, with Atlanta first in the Southeast and fifth in the East after a 5-5 stretch over their last ten, including a loss in their most recent game. Chicago has lost seven straight, sits 14th in the East, and is 5.5 games back in the Central. Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain (back), Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Tobe Awaka (back). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hawks lost 0-3 to the Bulls in the 2025-26 season series, most recently a 126-123 loss in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
